definitions.full: H3500. Yether III. יֶ֫תֶר proper name, masculine ( abundance ; on form and meaning of this and the following proper name see Lag BN 52, 198 ) — 1 father of Moses' wife Exod 4:18 a (E; probably text error, elsewhere יִתְרוֺ , q. v.) 2 eldest son of Gideon Judg 8:20 , ᵐ5 Ιεθερ . 3 father of Amasa 1Kin 2:5 , 32 ; 1Chr 2:17 , ᵐ5 Ιεθερ ; = יִתְרָא 2Sam 17:25 , ᵐ5 Ιοθερ , Ιοθορ ; ᵐ5 L Ιεθερ . 4 men of Judah , ᵐ5 Ιεθερ : a. 1Chr 2:32 (twice in verse). b. 1Chr 4:17 . 5 a man of Asher 1Chr 7:38 ( = יִתְרָן 7:37 ), ᵐ5 Ιεθερ , A Ιεθηρ , ᵐ5 L [ 7:39 ] Εθραν .
